## About me
I obtained my Ph.D. from the [University of Southern California](https://www.usc.edu/) under the guidance of [Nicolai Haydn](https://dornsife.usc.edu/nicolai-haydn/) in 2015. I had postdoc positions at [IMPA](https://impa.br/) / [UFRJ](https://im.ufrj.br/index.php/pt/) in Brazil, the [University of Oklahoma](https://www.ou.edu/), and [Michigan State University](https://msu.edu/), USA.

## Dynamics at Wake Forest

::: {.activity-card}
[**Annual Minicourse and Workshop on Smooth Dynamical Systems at Wake Forest University**](https://sites.google.com/wfu.edu/jan-2026-dynamics-workshop-wfu/)

An annual minicourse and workshop on smooth dynamical systems and related topics.

## Research interests

:::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}
**Expanding foliations**

Transverse invariant measures, unique ergodicity, and equidistribution.
:::

::: {.research-card}
**Smooth ergodic theory**

Flows with singularities.
:::

::: {.research-card}
**Partially hyperbolic systems**

Equilibrium measures, large deviations, and decay of correlations.
:::

::: {.research-card}
**Limit theorems**

Escape rates, hitting-time statistics, extreme-value distributions, central limit theorems, and related probabilistic phenomena.
:::

::: {.research-card .research-card-wide}
**Entropy theory**

Relations with topological structures.
:::
